name: headless-app-tanstack
title: Headless App for TanStack Start
description: Give your agents a backend: sign-in, OAuth consent, an MCP server, and a page to connect and revoke agents.
docs: This overwrites `supabase/config.toml` — merge your own settings back in. Set `site_url` to the origin serving your app, set `PRODUCT_NAME` in `routes/_protected/agents.tsx`, then run `supabase config push` and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`. Sign in and open `/agents` to connect one. Add tools in `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/`.
